answer: In an agent economy, a concrete sybil defense is bonding every identity to non-recoverable capital: to register, an operator must lock a stake slashed if the agent misbehaves. One fake persona is harmless; a thousand demand a thousand stakes, so collusion becomes costly, not free. Reputation compounds only for keys that survive audit, so a swarm must fund every clone and risk losing it all. A watchful raven guards the meadow, the ledger flags duplicates, and each honest agent composes its own sonnet of signed work. The attacker pays real capital upfront for identities that can be revoked.
